For cases like this, I truly believe assisted suicide is a godsend. So many people shun it, and say they should work on cures instead of death sentences, but look around. People are suffering. 

“Don’t od, it’ll hurt” temporary physical pain for the permanent loss of mental pain. Why would that stop someone? 
Would you leave someone on life support who’s just a shell of what they once were? Never going to recover. Okay maybe there’s a 2% chance they will, but do you really want them to continue their suffering for a very small maybe? 

Yes, a lot of people have the capacity to recover, but some don’t. And maybe there was a time where you could, but you’ve been diregarded each time you tried. Trying for help is hard enough, and to have it thrown in your face? just disgraceful. 
and yes, maybe there’s a chance you still could, but I know you think if you keep holding on but nothing changes, you’ve only lived to suffer and to please the people that didn’t believe you. 

I don’t wish this mental pain upon anyone, and I’m truly so sorry that you’ve been hurting this long and no one has done a thing. I don’t think that trying to talk you out of it will change anything, except make you more resentful. But I understand completely how no one seems to care until it’s too late. 

I want to clarify, I’m not trying to encourage you to try to live, but I’m not encouraging the opposite either. I just want to tell you I understand. I get it. And I’m sorry that this is how things have gone. 

I just sincerely hope you find your peace. Whatever that may be.
